title: Pairs of square-free arithmetic progressions in infinite words
summary: We study a question of Harju from 2019 regarding the existence of infinite ternary square-free words whose subsequences modulo $p$ and $q$ are also square-free for relatively prime integers $p$ and $q$. Among such pairs $(p, q)$ with $p, q \geq 3$, the only two pairs with this property known prior to this work were $(3, 11)$ and $(5, 6)$. We prove that there are finitely many pairs $(p, q)$ of relatively prime integers with $p, q \geq 3$ for which there is no infinite ternary square-free word whose subsequences modulo $p$ and $q$ are square-free.
